instructions.overview: OpenCore Studio supports fetching kexts directly from GitHub Releases or custom JSON repository feeds. You can add your own custom repository URL or GitHub organization/repo.

supportedTypes.description: Standard GitHub repository with release assets (e.g. 'acidanthera/Lilu'). OpenCore Studio queries the GitHub API '/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/latest' and looks for zip files containing '.kext' bundles.
Direct URL pointing to a JSON manifest listing kexts and their release download URLs, checksums, and version tags.
